query: Make a replica of this anodised aluminium wrist altimeter for our VR app. This straight-on product photo is all I have; the case is 63.5 x 63.5 x 28 mm.
files: <a straight-on product photo of a hand-held instrument with rounded corners>
expected_behavior: Says that a single straight-on photo only shows the widest outline, and searches for angled views (shops, video) before building
Shows whether the photo can measure each fitted parameter (scores the outline over a range of corner rounding) instead of trusting the fitted value
Builds a rounded case as a loft through sections rather than a box with chamfers and small fillets
Marks the sizes no photo constrains as guesses in spec.md
Uses metallic materials only if the target scene has environment lighting, otherwise a coated dielectric
